biggest_catch: Payout is explicitly variable with no guaranteed floor: the FAQ says 'this does NOT mean you are getting paid by the hour' - each experiment's exact payout is shown on SONA before you sign up.
catches: No guaranteed hourly rate or floor; payout varies per experiment (average cited is $20/hr)
Exact payout only disclosed per experiment on SONA before signup
Check payments must be claimed in person directly after the experiment - lost/expired checks are not reissued
Show-up fees apply if you arrive but the session is overfull; early arrivals get priority
Non-UC Berkeley community members only get occasional studies via the 'Paid studies for NON-Cal participants' SONA course

c1.evidence: xlab.berkeley.edu FAQ page indexed 2 days before verification; Haas participate page indexed 19 days before - both current

c2.evidence: XLab FAQ states 'average payment is $20 per hour of participation' over 1-1.5 hr experiments; Haas page states 'at least $15 an hour compensation'

c3.evidence: Steps from official pages: create SONA account, join the XLab pool, sign up for a study, attend, get paid

c4.evidence: Free to join on SONA; no fee; non-invasive lab experiments (questionnaires, economic games)

eligibility: UC Berkeley students and staff via SONA; community members (non-Cal) eligible for occasional studies via the 'Paid studies for NON-Cal participants' SONA course
notes: Two official UC Berkeley sources corroborate: the XLab's own FAQ (average $20/hr, 1-1.5 hr sessions, check or Amazon payout) and the Haas BIBS participate page (at least $15/hr). payout_max assumes a 1.5 hr session at the average rate; floor set to 0 because the FAQ explicitly denies a guaranteed hourly rate.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (average $20/hr over stated 1-1.5 hr experiments; no floor since rate is explicitly not guaranteed); time: stated 60-90 min experiments plus SONA signup and screening estimate
payout_quote: Payouts vary, but the average payment is $20 per hour of participation (however, this does NOT mean you are getting paid by the hour. Some participants may receive more, some may receive less). The payout is given out by check directly after the experiment or virtually (Amazon.com), which may take longer.
payout_value_note: Average cash-equivalent per-hour figure from the XLab FAQ; per-experiment payouts vary and are shown on SONA before signup.

s1.note: Provider's own stated average hourly figure; Amazon payout treated at face value

s2.note: Framed as variable per-experiment pay with no guaranteed floor, per the FAQ's own disclaimer

s3.note: Catches cover no floor, check-claim rules, overfull-session show-up fees

s5.note: Timing: check directly after experiment; virtual (Amazon) payout may take longer

s6.note: Deduped: no UC Berkeley / XLab route in catalog or evidence files

s7.note: FAQ's variability disclaimer quoted; no inflated guarantee

steps: Create a SONA account (UC Berkeley affiliates join the XLab pool; non-affiliates join the 'Paid studies for NON-Cal participants' course)
Check each experiment's study information on SONA for its stated payout
Sign up for an experiment slot
Attend the in-lab session at the XLab (non-invasive, questionnaires/economic games)
Claim your check directly after the experiment or receive virtual payout
timing: Check paid directly after the experiment; virtual (Amazon.com) payout may take longer.
